items.headline: Western Michigan builds big lead early, holds off Eastern Michigan 34-27
items.description: — Jalen Buckley ran for 140 yards and two touchdowns, including a 72-yarder on the first play from scrimmage, to lead Western Michigan to a 34-27 victory over Eastern Michigan on Tuesday night.
